source.title: Graph Theory: Favorite Conjectures and Open Problems - 1

trace.notes: Normalized the single input URL https://zbmath.org/6567208 as a zbMATH resolver. Local shell fetches to zbmath.org, www.zbmath.org, and api.zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution errors in the restricted environment. Browser/search recovery and repository shard metadata identified zbMATH document 6567208 as the Springer book Graph Theory: Favorite Conjectures and Open Problems - 1 with DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-31940-7.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted with metadata_only fallbacks. The Springer Nature page for DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-31940-7 states that the book is subscription preview content and offers purchase or institutional access; it exposes bibliographic metadata, table of contents, and chapter summaries rather than readable full text. ResearchGate and Google Books pages exposed metadata, abstracts, snippets, or chapter summaries, not a readable exact-work full-text artifact suitable for extraction.

No doc_map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered. The visible resolver pages were treated only as identity metadata and were not used as technical evidence.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source within the bounded recovery pass. Exact-work attempts included the zbMATH URL, the DOI landing page, exact DOI plus PDF search, exact title plus PDF search, the Springer book page, ResearchGate book/chapter metadata, and Google Books metadata. Candidate pages were rejected because they were subscription restricted, metadata-only, abstract-only, snippet-only, or not source-authorized full text.
Saved the exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/6567208.json and outputs/latest.json.
